answer: Require each agent identity to pass a liveness-checked biometric enrollment: a live face scan, matched against all existing templates with privacy-preserving comparison that never stores raw images. One face can anchor only one identity, like a single block of marble cut into one statue - a cedar forest grows one trunk per seed, and quartz forms one crystal per pocket. An attacker needing a thousand fake identities must recruit a thousand distinct living people, each paid and present for a live check, so the cost of forgery scales linearly with the attack instead of staying near zero.
